# New York State Education Department

> NYSED is the state agency overseeing K-12 and higher education in New York, governed by the Board of Regents and led by Commissioner Betty A. Rosa.

The New York State Education Department (NYSED) serves as the primary regulatory and administrative body for education across New York State. It coordinates with the Board of Regents, manages special education appeals through the Office of State Review, and provides legal guidance through the Office of Counsel.

## Core Services & Portals

- [New York State Education Department](https://www.nysed.gov): NYSED homepage providing access to education programs and services.
- [Board of Regents](https://www.regents.nysed.gov): Board of Regents homepage overseeing NY State education system.
- [NYSED Application Business Portal - Dashboard](https://portal.nysed.gov/abp): NYSED portal for accessing applications and education services.
- [Office of Counsel](https://www.counsel.nysed.gov): Office of Counsel providing legal services and education policy guidance.
- [Office of State Review](https://www.sro.nysed.gov): Office of State Review handling special education appeals and hearings.

## Governance & Leadership

- [About NYSED](https://www.nysed.gov/about): About NYSED mission, vision, and organizational structure.
- [Commissioner Betty A. Rosa](https://www.nysed.gov/about/commissioner): Biography of Commissioner Betty A. Rosa and NYSED leadership.
- [Office of Governmental Relations](https://www.oms.nysed.gov/legcoord): Office of Governmental Relations facilitating legislative and policy advocacy.
- [Office of Human Resources](https://www.nysed.gov/hr): NYSED Human Resources office for employment and HR services.

## Rules, Regulations & Legal Resources

- [Rules and Regulations](https://www.counsel.nysed.gov/rulesandregs): NY education rules, regulations, and commissioner amendments.
- [FOIL Requests](https://www.nysed.gov/new-york-state-education-department-foil-requests): FOIL and Freedom of Information Law request process and procedures.
